target.role: Associate Director, Enterprise Model Risk Management

summary: Model validation and model risk governance specialist with ~7 years of quantitative model development, validation, and governance experience, applying for the Associate Director, Enterprise Model Risk Management role at RBC. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), and sits on the model governance committee shaping methodology, documentation, and benchmarking standards for client-delivered analytics. Proficient Python and SQL practitioner with Monte Carlo and stress-testing depth; CFA charterholder with dual MSc degrees in Financial Modelling and Chemical Engineering. OSFI E-23 / SR 11-7-aligned model-governance awareness.

sections.heading: Independent Model Review, Testing & Challenge
bullets: Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement; ~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, cross-checking sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.

Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility - held one client release 48 hours until a curve-calibration edge case was diagnosed, remediated upstream, and captured in standing validation tests.

sections.heading: Model Governance, Documentation & Validation Reporting
bullets: Contributed as a member of the model governance committee to methodology review, model documentation and benchmarking standards, and model performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Operated within a formal model governance framework - assessing assumptions, testing economic defensibility, and building documentation standards consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23-style expectations.

Produced analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on scenario impacts and balance-sheet sensitivities, converting quantitative findings into conclusions and recommendations for Heads of Risk and investment committees.

sections.heading: Quantitative Development, Python & Data Analytics
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across ALM horizons.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls; ran shadow-mode reconciliation for two cycles before cutover.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms; validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated client investment-team requirements into structured development requests, working between client stakeholders and product owners to reach agreed specifications.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes; coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on milestone delivery.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.
Presented ALM study findings to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
